scoring_justification: Result-level comparison against paper-reported gold from Figures 5, 7, 10 plus structural check for islanding onset; full recompute from raw trajectories is infeasible without running the expensive Monte Carlo simulation.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for surface composition, depth profile, and chemical potentials
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures (Fig. 5, Fig. 7, Fig. 10) and text (µ_island = 31 meV/atom)
hidden_assets.generation_method: read off from paper plots and summary text; island potential taken from paper's stated value
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported quantities used as reference for reproduction verification

outputs.description: Surface Ge atomic fraction after 1 ML Ge/Si(001) equilibration at 600°C. The checker compares against the paper-reported value from Figure 5.
Ge composition profile (fraction) across the top 7 layers after 7 ML growth at 800°C. Compared to the paper's depth profile (Figure 7).
Chemical potentials (eV) for epilayers 1 through 7. Checker compares to Figure 10 and also verifies that μ < 0.031 eV for layers 1-3 and μ ≥ 0.031 eV for layer 4 (islanding onset).

output_contract.notes: Scoring uses a result-level compare (T0) against hidden paper-reported values from Figures 5, 7, and 10, with appropriate tolerances. An additional structural check (T3) on the chemical potential array ensures the islanding onset after 3-4 monolayers is captured.
